It was also charged with the statutory duty of preparing the Zonal Development Plans, which included the lay-out of various colonies in Delhi. The colony of Vasant Kunj was one such colony conceived of under the Zonal Development Plans prepared by Delhi Development Authority and for which, after acquiring the lands the Central Government placed the same at the disposal of Delhi Development Authority for development; residential plots to be sold and flats constructed on some land to be sold to the allottees by Delhi Development Authority. 2.
